verdict.rationale: The docs point developers to the open-source library for a local agent (docs-19, probe-1). The GitHub repo pitches a Python library you run from your own code with any LLM (gh-3). Community users confirm running it locally against their own Chrome and logged-in profile (comm-5, comm-3), though comm-3 notes the local setup opens an unauthenticated debugging port that is exposed to XSS. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that no cloud account or API key is needed, and in-depth local quickstart or local-browser configuration docs in the pack.
